text:
Meeting deadlines is a skill that improves with practice. Effective time management starts with breaking a large project into smaller, daily tasks. This prevents last-minute panic and helps you track your progress. Prioritization is equally important; identify which tasks are urgent and which can wait, focusing your energy on what truly matters.

Scope management means knowing your limits. If a request expands beyond your original plan, it is crucial to say so politely. Finally, maintain clear communication with your team or client. If you foresee a delay, inform them early. Sharing updates builds trust and often provides the support you need to deliver on time.
